changes.old_rule: NFL Pulse could be linked to Sparta recommendations without a required decision-level lineage schema.
changes.new_rule: Every material Sparta decision must carry explicit NFL Pulse lineage fields, with null lineage details when pulse_used=FALSE.
changes.reason: Make Pulse influence auditable and measurable at decision level without duplicating the full Pulse database.
changes.expected_effect: Traceable Pulse-to-decision causality and better post-outcome evaluation.

changes.old_rule: Repeated mentions of the same NFL fact could be counted as separate signals unless manually reconciled.
changes.new_rule: Treat one underlying NFL fact as one information event even when repeated by Pulse, web, beat reporters, fantasy analysts, or news aggregators; store multiple sources as corroboration rather than independent confidence votes.
changes.reason: Prevent artificial confidence inflation and signal double-counting.
changes.expected_effect: Cleaner confidence calibration and more accurate source-performance measurement.

changes.old_rule: Pulse usefulness was tracked only as a general aggregate.
changes.new_rule: Grade materially used Pulse intelligence as HIGHLY_USEFUL, USEFUL, ACCURATE_NOT_ACTIONABLE, DUPLICATIVE, TOO_LATE, MISLEADING, WRONG, or UNRESOLVED using accuracy, timeliness, decision impact, mistake prevention, roster value, false alarms, and redundancy—not fantasy result alone.
changes.reason: Separate information quality from downstream fantasy variance.
changes.expected_effect: Identify which Pulse categories and sources actually improve Sparta decisions.

changes.old_rule: Weekly learning reviews did not require a dedicated NFL Pulse performance section.
changes.new_rule: Every weekly Sparta learning review must include NFL Pulse performance metrics, including considered/used/rejected counts, actions changed, outcomes, lead time, usefulness grades, category performance, and source performance.
changes.reason: Make Pulse performance visible and comparable week over week.
changes.expected_effect: Cumulative evidence for whether Pulse is early, accurate, and decision-improving.

changes.old_rule: Pulse-derived rules followed the general repeated-evidence standard.
changes.new_rule: Do not promote a Pulse-derived signal into a permanent Sparta rule from one ordinary result; require repeated evidence unless a clear structural defect is exposed.
changes.reason: Avoid overfitting to isolated Pulse wins or failures.
changes.expected_effect: More stable and evidence-based Pulse learning.
